description: Dependency policy enforced by scripts/check-dependencies.mjs (pnpm deps:check, part of pnpm security, pnpm verify and CI). See SECURITY.md#dependency-policy. Changing this file is a reviewed decision (CODEOWNERS).

installSettings.description: What pnpm-workspace.yaml must keep, so weakening the supply-chain settings fails the gate instead of passing unnoticed (scripts/install-settings.mjs): the release delay and the trust policy's window (minutes, at least), the settings with one accepted value, the settings left at pnpm's safe default, and the reviewed exceptions, each with its reason.

exceptions.description: Entries of pnpm-workspace.yaml that weaken a setting, each a reviewed decision: allowBuilds entries not set to false and trustPolicyExclude entries, by their exact text, with { reason }; minimumReleaseAgeExclude entries (exact versions only), with { reason, expires }. From the date in expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most the release delay plus a day ahead) the check fails until the entry is deleted from both files. An exception whose entry is gone fails too.

argon2.reason: Native password hashing of the API (apps/api): the install script selects the prebuilt binding for the platform, or compiles it. Without it argon2 cannot load.

@prisma/engines.reason: Prisma (apps/api): the install script downloads the query and schema engines for the platform, checked against the release checksums. Without them Prisma cannot generate its client or run migrations.

prisma.reason: Prisma CLI (apps/api): its install script prepares the engines @prisma/engines downloads; the migrations and the client generation need it.

body-parser@2.4.0.reason: GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828 (high, published 2026-10-23): a denial of service through trailing bytes after a compressed request body, on every JSON route of the API (express 5). Published 2026-10-22; forced by the express>body-parser override.

multer@2.5.0.reason: GHSA-q7qp-rjg7-q26m (high, published 2026-10-23): a denial of service through a pending asynchronous fileFilter; @nestjs/platform-express 12.1.3 pins 2.4.0 into the API image (no route takes uploads). Published 2026-10-22; forced by the @nestjs/platform-express>multer override.

nodemailer@10.1.4.reason: GHSA-8c8m-p3m8-cjg8, GHSA-m943-m63m-w62w and GHSA-85x2-q946-cp5h (moderate, published 2026-10-23): the API's mail transport. Published 2026-10-18; the API requires ^10.1.4.

fast-uri@3.1.9.reason: GHSA-w74x-v6f9-j3xg, GHSA-wjr9-j795-jxcr (moderate), GHSA-xhq7-xmqj-769h and GHSA-333x-w4r6-6crp (low), published 2026-10-23: ajv's URI parser in development tools only (commitlint, secretlint, the Nest CLI, the Prisma CLI, astro check). Published 2026-10-19; forced by the ajv>fast-uri override.
